sma.formula: Simple Moving Average over rolling window: (1/N) * sum(prices)

ema.formula: Exponential Moving Average seeded by SMA of first N prices; k = 2 / (period + 1)

rsi.formula: Relative Strength Index using Wilder's RMA of gains and losses
rsi.reference: Wilder, J. W. (1978). New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems / TA-Lib RSI / technicalindicators RSI

macd.formula: MACD line = EMA(fast) - EMA(slow); Signal = EMA(MACD, signalPeriod); Histogram = MACD - Signal
macd.reference: Appel, G. (1979) / TA-Lib MACD / technicalindicators MACD

bbands.formula: Basis = SMA(period); Upper/Lower = Basis +/- stdDevMultiplier * PopulationStdDev
bbands.reference: Bollinger, J. (2001). Bollinger on Bollinger Bands / TA-Lib BBANDS / technicalindicators BollingerBands

atr.formula: Average True Range using Wilder's RMA of True Range, seeded by SMA of first period true ranges
atr.reference: Wilder, J. W. (1978) / TA-Lib ATR / technicalindicators ATR

adx.formula: Average Directional Movement Index using Wilder smoothing of +DI/-DI and DX
adx.reference: Wilder, J. W. (1978) / TA-Lib ADX / technicalindicators ADX

obv.formula: On-Balance Volume: Granville (1963). Cumulative sum of directional volume signed by sign(close_t - close_{t-1}). Initialized at 0 in ta-crypto vs volume[0] in TA-Lib; compared by rebased trajectory / delta parity.
obv.reference: Granville, J. (1963). Granville's New Key to Stock Market Profits / TA-Lib OBV (origin=volume[0]) / technicalindicators OBV (origin=0)

mfi.reference: Quong, G., & May, A. (1989). Money Flow Index / TA-Lib MFI / technicalindicators MFI

stoch.formula: Stochastic Oscillator: %K = (close - LL) / (HH - LL) * 100, %D = SMA(%K, dLength)
stoch.reference: Lane, G. (1950s) / TA-Lib STOCH / technicalindicators Stochastic

rules.alignment: left-pad reference series with null/NaN to full length and compare only overlapping non-null points
